title: Known Marketplaces Registry
description: `~/.claude/plugins/known_marketplaces.json` (and the structurally identical `extraKnownMarketplaces` value shape embedded in `.claude/settings.json`/`settings.local.json`). Top-level object keyed by marketplace name. IMPORTANT: this single file is read by two independent Rust consumers with two independently-required fields per entry, so a real, fully-functional file must carry BOTH: (1) `source` — required by `SettingsEntry { source: SettingsSource }`, used to auto-register marketplace sources; and (2) `installLocation` — required by `KnownMarketplaceEntry { install_location: PathBuf }` (camelCase), used to discover installed plugin directories under the marketplace root. Neither consumer uses `deny_unknown_fields`, so each tolerates the other's required key as an ignored extra field; this schema documents the union so the file satisfies both.

knownMarketplaceEntry.description: One marketplace entry. Required-by-union of two independent Rust structs reading the same file (see top-level description).

installLocation.description: Local filesystem path where the marketplace repo/dir was cloned/installed. Required field on `KnownMarketplaceEntry` (`#[serde(rename_all = "camelCase")]` renames `install_location`).

lastUpdated.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the last marketplace refresh. Not read by either grok consumer (ignored as an unknown field); present in the real Claude-Code-compatible format.

autoUpdate.description: Whether this marketplace auto-updates. Not read by either grok consumer (ignored as an unknown field); present in the real Claude-Code-compatible format.

settingsSource.description: Discriminated by the inner `"source"` field. `#[serde(tag = "source", rename_all = "lowercase")] enum SettingsSource { Git{url}, Github{repo}, Local{path} }`.

url.description: Git remote URL. Required field of the `Git` variant.

repo.description: `owner/repo` shorthand, expanded to `https://github.com/<repo>.git`. Required field of the `Github` variant.

path.description: Local filesystem path; `~` is expanded to the home directory. Required field of the `Local` variant.
